title: A supplied polynomial-entropy tree disperser with eventual 4N-N^(3/5) bound

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic P family family.evaluate defined by proof.md, with exact integer tree padding, fixed source/extractor parameters, supplied field construction and numerical fallback0. At actual N it zero-pads into n=t^J>=N, t=2^ceil((ceil(log2 N))^(3/10)), uses k=floor(sqrt n), Kmin=floor(sqrt k), the supplied linear code/design extractors, affine row and block-source extractors, and the stated challenge-response tree. Every input bit is charged. No program prefix, field input, advice or witness is used.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this ONE fixed total uniform P language, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exists N0 such that for EVERY integer N>=N0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^(3/5). Thus liminf over ALL integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. The supplied arguments prove prime-degree fields, a trace-cubic extractor, linear strong seeded extraction, affine somewhere-random and block-source extraction, the recursive challenge-response disperser at padded threshold floor(sqrt n), and the unrestricted full-B2 gate transfer at actual length N. Finite small lengths use the fixed total numerical fallbacks; no explicit N0 or practical running time at every asymptotically large input length is claimed. All helper algorithms and hypotheses are supplied, not admitted by prior verdict or external retrieval.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
